svg.title: Tools: what to buy, what to print
svg.desc: The fourteen things to buy, in two groups with their prices and totals; the bench helpers and parts to print on the Bambu Lab P1S instead of buying; and the small hardware and consumables to buy.
svg.text: Tools: what to buy, what to print
Fourteen things to buy, the things the printer makes instead, and the small hardware. Prices are rough, in US dollars.

svg.text: Nothing printed goes near the hot iron: its hot end rests on metal, the bought stand or the printed stand's steel bearing.
The screws cut their own thread in printed 2.1 mm holes, so no threaded inserts are needed.
